notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
This update adds an Annotation system into the game which includes...

1.) Notes - Users can now create notes that are linked to specific verses and translations of The Bible. 

2.) Custom Notes - Users can also create custom notes not linked to any particular passage or translation, from the Annotations menu. 

3.) Verse Highlighting - Users can now click on any verse in order to highlight it, verse highlights are specific to the translation being read at the time. 

4.) Annotations Menu - Users now have a place where all notes and highlights will be stored and organized. With the ability to filter by translation. 

5.) The game's Main Menu has been overhauled to provide a more aesthetically appropriate and pleasing experience for players. 




MISC.

Other small tweaks were made to the system, adding the ability to navigate within notes via the arrow keys and the use of the enter button, to make editing and altering notes easier. 

Ability to navigate annotations menus and scrollbars using the mousewheel and arrow keys. 

Adding sound effects for the various new buttons in annotations and the main menu.

notes.title: Ver. 1.12 _ Achievements Fixed
notes.content:
1.) Steam Achievements have been reactivated

2.) Reading Icons have been added to show players what chapters of what books in which translations they have previously read. 

3.) Reading achievements can now be activated over multiple play sessions. You may read any book in any order over multiple sessions and the achievement for it will trigger. 

4.) Local\Offline achievements with their own pop-up have been implemented as well. 

5.) Nehemiah, Song of Solomon, Lamentations, and Malachi - When players reached the end of these book in any Protestant translation it caused the game to crash. This has been fixed and no longer occurs. 

6.) Mana Unlock System has been fixed - It always worked on steam, but fixing the achievements broke the mana system, so we had to fix that as a result. 

7.) Minor alteration to grammar of a few questions to improve clarity. As well as changing the answer to a question in Quiz 3, a wrong answer was registering as correct, this no longer happens.

notes.title: BIBLE VER 1.11 _ Trivia Overhaul, Catholic Deuterocanon, Steam Cloud, and More
notes.content:
2 New Bible Translations that contain the Catholic Deuterocanon. 

Steam Cloud 

Partial Controller Support

Search Filter - User can now choose which translation they would like to search for words and phrases in, instead of getting results for all translations simultaneously. 

TRIVIA OVERHAUL - New Models, Textures, Sound Effects, Simulations, Score Tracking, Animations, Menus, and Unlock System. 

Added 677 new Trivia Questions

ACHIEVEMENTS - Changed conditions for earning pre-existing achievements, also added a variety of new achievements. New achievements are related to the trivia overhauls, and the inclusion of new Biblical Translations. 
Added 5 new Quizzes. New Quizzes will comprehensively test the knowledge of the user on a specific book of the Bible. Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy all have Quizzes now. More Quizzes will be added over time until each book of the Bible has its own. 

High Contrast Text - Added option for ease of visibility when playing Trivia, making it more accessible for users with poor vision. 

Trivia Menu - Quiz selection menu has been altered to be more appealing. Also now displays the user's highest score on each Quiz. 

Jar of Mana Unlock - When users get a Perfect Score on any Quiz they now unlock  "Jar of Mana" which can be used to unlock any Quiz which the user does not currently have access to. 

Created new sub menu to distinguish between Catholic and Protestant translations, making it easier for users to find the version they would like to read or study with greater ease. 

Search Menu - In addition to adding the ability to filter search results by translation, the Search menu itself has been altered to be more appealing visually, as well as more easily readable for the visually impaired.

notes.title: The Bible version 1.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bible Search – Added feature where users can look for any word or phrase. All instances of that word or phrase in all translations will be displayed in a list. When the user selects one of the search results that word or phrase will appear highlighted everywhere it appears in a given chapter of the Bible. 

King James Version Bible has been added

American Standard Version Bible has been added

Young’s Literal Translation Bible has been added

Darby Translation Bible has been added

Reina-Valera Antigua Bible has been added

RMB – Flips back a page

Audiobook no longer plays when pausing the game and navigating through other menus.

Added Title Screen button to bottom of screen while reading to make navigation through the game easier.

Improved functionality of ‘Back’ button at bottom of screen, and it now indicates where exactly the user will be taken back to when it is clicked. 

World English Bible Translation was removed and re-implemented with improved formatting. 

Verse numbers are now highlighted and underlined in all translations to improve readability.

Added notation in the upper margin when reading which indicates what book and chapter the user is in at all times.

notes.title: Patch 1.001
notes.content:
Bug Fix - Game would crash when players tried to open chapters 2, 3, 4, or 5 of the book 1 John. This has been fixed.
